fullPassage: When you purchase an item, you are paying not just for the item, but the costs to get that item to you. Let's say you visit a farm and buy a tomato. It might cost the farmer very little to grow a tomato, so the farmer might be able to sell you a tomato for much less than it would cost in the supermarket and still make a nice profit. When you buy that tomato at a supermarket, however, there are a number of costs that result in you paying much more than you would pay the farmer. That tomato has to be transported to the store the store must pay rent, electric bills, and employee wages; and the store advertises tomatoes in its weekly newspaper ad.

det.korean: (A) purchase(구입하다), (B) profit(수익), (C) advertises(광고하다) — 원문 일치

✅ ② purchase — profit — advertises: 원문 그대로 — 물건을 구입하고, 수익을 남기며, 가게가 광고한다 ←정답
❌ ③ purchase — loss — conceals: loss(손실)는 profit 반의어, conceals는 advertises 반의어
❌ ④ return — loss — advertises: return과 loss가 원문 반의어

questions.passage: When you purchase an item, you are paying not just for the item, but the costs to get that item to you. Let's say you visit a farm and buy a tomato. It might cost the farmer very little to grow a tomato, so the farmer might be able to sell you a tomato for __________ than it would cost in the supermarket and still make a nice profit. When you buy that tomato at a supermarket, however, there are a number of costs that result in you paying much more than you would pay the farmer. That tomato has to be transported to the store the store must pay rent, electric bills, and employee wages; and the store advertises tomatoes in its weekly newspaper ad.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: much less(훨씬 더 적게): 슈퍼마켓보다 훨씬 더 적은 가격에 판매할 수 있다
det.analysis:
❌ ① much more(훨씬 더 많이): 농부가 싸게 파는 맥락과 반대
✅ ② much less(훨씬 더 적게): 슈퍼마켓 가격보다 '훨씬 적은' 가격에 팔 수 있다 ←정답
❌ ③ a little(약간): 비교 맥락에 부적절
❌ ④ the same(같은 정도): 농부가 더 싸게 파는 맥락과 모순

questions.passage: When you purchase an item, you are paying not just for the item, but the costs to get that item to you. Let's say you visit a farm and buy a tomato. It might cost the farmer very little to grow a tomato, so the farmer might be able to sell you a tomato for much less than it would cost in the supermarket and still make a nice profit. When you buy that tomato at a supermarket, however, there are __________ costs that result in you paying much more than you would pay the farmer. That tomato has to be transported to the store the store must pay rent, electric bills, and employee wages; and the store advertises tomatoes in its weekly newspaper ad.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: a number of(많은): 슈퍼마켓에서 사면 많은 비용이 발생한다
det.analysis:
❌ ① a lack of(~의 부족): 비용이 부족하다는 것은 맥락과 모순
❌ ② a series of(일련의): 가능하나 원문 표현은 a number of
❌ ③ a piece of(한 조각의): 불가산명사 수식어로 costs(복수)와 결합 불가
✅ ④ a number of(많은, 다수의): 슈퍼마켓에서 사면 '다수의' 추가 비용이 발생한다 ←정답
